meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把问题交给一个多角色「思维委员会」:选 4–6 个不同风格的角色,各自陈述立场、推理、风险与洞见,最后汇总出核心分歧、盲点、建议路径和置信度。
howto.when: 当用户希望从多角度审视问题、模拟委员会/多方辩论来辅助决策,或说出“council mode”等指令时,该技能被触发。

say.text: 帮我开个思维委员会,讨论要不要辞职创业。
say.note: Claude会召唤多个角色并汇总建议。

say.text: 从战略、伦理和务实角度评价这个商业决策。
say.note: 自动选用对应专家组进行辩论与综合。

say.text: Council mode: 从所有角度思考这个决定。

howto.what_en: Claude will run a multi-perspective Council. It picks 4-6 archetypes from 12 styles, each sharing a stance, reasoning, key risk, and insight, then synthesizes core tensions, blind spots, and a recommended path with confidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants diverse viewpoints, asks for a council/board/panel discussion, or mentions 'council mode' or similar; also when facing a dilemma or trade-off.

say_en.text: Run a mind council on whether I should quit my job to start a company.
say_en.note: It will gather roles and synthesize advice.

say_en.text: Assess this business decision from strategic, ethical, and pragmatic angles.
say_en.note: It chooses matching archetypes for deliberation.

say_en.text: Council mode: think through this from all sides.
